digest.component_or_area: plan-review batch runner / pass-1 usage aggregation
propositions: Pass-1 pass functions (pass1_chunk, pass1_container, pass1_isf) discard per-call usage attached by runner, blocking token totals and per-criterion request counts in plan-review coverage metrics

Usage records must be threaded through the entire call chain (sizing.pass1_with_ladder → passes → concurrent collectors) and aggregated per-call with criteria attribution, then summarized per-criterion with token fields divided equally across multi-criterion chunks
Ladder retry attempts each contribute a separate call record; checkpoint-served chunks contribute no usage; raising attempts contribute no usage (limitation documented)
run_focused_finder must return usage summed over all its internal runner calls and be merged into the batch output before emitting BatchRunResult.outputs['_usage']
Sidecar payload must expose coverage.usage with per_call (raw call records) and per_criterion (derived map) keys; coverage.metrics must be extended with aggregated token totals
All external callers of the changed pass functions and run_focused_finder (eval_solver, criterion_preview, fidelity_spot_eval) must be updated atomically to unpack and handle the new return shapes
